plain_text:
Fitness trainer and
entrepreneur Cassey Ho has
won a large audience through
her online fitness videos and
social media presence. She sees
fitness and nutrition as the keys
to a balanced and healthy lifestyle.
She is also outspoken about the
importance of having a healthy,
positive body image. Cassey spoke
to NIH MedlinePlus magazine about
her work and shared advice for
others looking to improve their
fitness and overall wellness.

plain_text:
Research has clearly shown that regular exercise
has many health benefits. How do you view the
relationship between physical fitness and overall
health and well-being?
semantic_text: Research has clearly shown that regular exercise has many health benefits. How do you view the relationship between physical fitness and overall health and well-being?

plain_text:
Fitness is all about building mental, emotional, and
physical strength. When you're able to find the joy in your
daily movement—like finding a workout that makes you
smile—that is when you will find consistency. And guess
what? Consistency is the key to seeing real changes in your
body and your life.

plain_text:
What's your take on individual differences when it
comes to having a healthy, balanced lifestyle?
semantic_text: What's your take on individual differences when it comes to having a healthy, balanced lifestyle?

plain_text:
Everyone is different. We each have a different genetic
makeup, we come from different ethnicities, and we have
different needs and wants. So how can we possibly be
prescribed the same eating plan and workout regimen? It
is important to understand that what works for one person
may not work for another. It took me many years to finally
realize that.
